name: Spending credit on visual projects
summary: The one credit check a visual project goes through: who may spend credit, how much is taken, what happens when there isn't enough, and what can't change afterwards. Work in progress: only on the feature/progress-linked-credit branches, not on track-3d.

roles.note: Spending credit is tied to approving a visual project, not to a catalog permission. Sales (system role) may also approve and may override; shown under support-user as conditional.

actions.note: Sales role only among Track3D staff
A non-super-admin's project is created pending; credit is taken when a super admin approves it

actions.action: Go beyond the pool with a reason

nfr.statement: Two visual projects created at the same moment must not overdraw the pool.
nfr.open_question: Code retries a conflicting write up to five times, then asks the user to retry. Is that acceptable under load, and how many simultaneous creations per company should be supported?

requirements.title: A visual project takes credit for its full size once
requirements.statement: Under the credit model, a visual project needs a size in square feet (or square metres). When it becomes approved, its full size is taken from the pool in one go, from the soonest-ending lot first. It is never checked again; later changes to the pool do not stop it.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d.

acceptance_criteria.given: A pool with lot A (100,000 sq ft left, ends in June) and lot B (500,000 sq ft left, ends in December)
acceptance_criteria.when: A super admin creates a 150,000 sq ft visual project
acceptance_criteria.then: Lot A is used up and 50,000 sq ft is taken from lot B

acceptance_criteria.given: A visual project with no size, or only a money value
acceptance_criteria.when: It is created or approved under the credit model
acceptance_criteria.then: It is refused and the user is asked for its size in square feet

requirements.title: Only super admins and Sales spend credit
requirements.statement: Only the company's super admins and Track3D Sales may approve a visual project on the credit model. A visual project created by anyone else, including one that the regional or allowlist auto-approval would approve, is saved as pending approval and holds no credit until a super admin approves it. Drafts and pending projects hold no credit.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (constructn-api@984e5354512a, project-api@0b8add5cbba5); not on track-3d. It changes the auto-approval outcome described in PROJ-REQ-004 for visual projects.

acceptance_criteria.given: A regional admin whose projects are normally auto-approved
acceptance_criteria.when: They create a visual project under the credit model
acceptance_criteria.then: It is saved as Pending approval and no credit is taken

acceptance_criteria.when: A project admin who is not a company super admin tries to approve it
acceptance_criteria.then: It is refused with "Only a super admin can approve visual projects."

requirements.title: Visual projects are refused without enough credit, and Sales are told
requirements.statement: A visual project is refused when the company is not on the credit model, has no active progress project, or has less available credit than the project's size. The customer is told how much is available and to contact Sales. Each refusal is logged, and Sales get one open notification per company per day (with an email), with repeat attempts counted on it.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, db-models@39f53b96975a); not on track-3d.

acceptance_criteria.when: A super admin creates a 60,000 sq ft visual project
acceptance_criteria.then: It is refused with a message saying 40,000 sq ft is available and to contact Sales, and a blocked-no-credit entry is logged

acceptance_criteria.given: The same company is refused three times in one day

requirements.title: A visual project's size and a project's intent are fixed for customers
requirements.statement: Under the credit model, a visual project's size can't be changed after it is created, and only Sales can change a project between progress and visual. A paid visual-only project may be resized by Sales only.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d.

requirements.title: Credit taken for a project that was never saved is handed back
requirements.statement: If a visual project's save or approval fails after its credit was taken, the credit is handed back to lots that are still active. If that call is lost, the sweep hands back any draw whose project still doesn't hold it after a 15-minute grace period (looking back one day). A draw whose project holds the credit can't be handed back.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (project-api@0b8add5cbba5, constructn-api@984e5354512a); not on track-3d.

acceptance_criteria.given: Credit was taken for a new visual project and the project save then failed
acceptance_criteria.when: 15 minutes pass and the sweep runs
acceptance_criteria.then: The credit returns to its active lots and a draw-cancelled entry is logged

requirements.title: Credit data can't be set from a project request
requirements.statement: A project's credit marker (progress or visual, size, funding, grandfathered) is written only by the credit service. Create and update requests have any credit fields, and any override, removed before they are used. Only a Sales user's override reason is honoured.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (constructn-api@984e5354512a, db-models@39f53b96975a); not on track-3d. Protects the pool from being bypassed by a crafted request.

requirements.title: Customers see their company's credit
requirements.statement: Above the projects list, customers on the credit model see their company's available visual project credit, credit starting later, and the next expiry. The new-project form checks the size against the balance and, for super admins, blocks Create when credit is missing or short. Sales do not see this strip.
requirements.rationale: Only on feature/progress-linked-credit (track3d-web@af7f2c449f38, project-api@0b8add5cbba5); not on track-3d or track3d-web main. Shown only when the web credit flag is on.
